d:
Ameriki rashtrapti donald tranp ne apne qaribi sahyogi stifan milar ko naya chif of staf niyukt kiya hai. yah faisla aise samay men liya gaya hai, jab midtarm chunav men ripablikan parti ko karari har ka samna karna para hai. milar ko tranp ka bharosemand sahyogi mana jata hai. unki pahchan amerika ki sakht imigreshan niti ko aakar dene vale 'mastarmaind' ke taur par rahi hai. milar ki niyukti bharat ke lihaz se bhi aham mani ja rahi hai. iski vajah bharat ko lekar unke pahle die gae bayan hain.
Riport raunak bhaira
Aavaz mohammad shahid
